title: Rokn
short_description: Arabic courses with short connected video lessons and a clear course map
full_description:
Scroll and learn with Rokn

Rokn offers focused Arabic courses made of short, connected video lessons. Watch vertically and swipe between lessons.

Lessons and a course map
Browse units and lessons on the course map, track your progress, save videos to revisit and resume watching where you stopped.

Projects and questions
Apply what you learn in projects and follow their requirements and results. Ask questions about lessons or projects and use review reports to understand what needs improvement.

Your work and certificates
Choose work to add to your portfolio and share it with a single link. Receive a verifiable completion certificate after meeting the course requirements.

Projects, questions, review reports and certificates depend on your course and plan. Included features, limits and prices are shown before purchase.

Explore the available free content and choose what you want to learn. The app interface is in Arabic.
